$comment: Copy to shipboard.runner.json (or pass --config <file>). Every key is optional; these are the defaults unless noted. Precedence: defaults < this file < env (SHIPBOARD_URL, SHIPBOARD_RUNNER_TOKEN) < flags (--url --agents --concurrency --job-timeout --once --dry-run). The runner token is read from SHIPBOARD_RUNNER_TOKEN only, never from this file. Run `npm run runner -- --dry-run` to see what resolves.

templates.$comment: Keyed by agent id (the ids the board dispatches to). An entry replaces only the fields it names; the rest comes from the built-in template for its kind (claude, codex, grok, cursor) or, for kind script, from {args: ["{prompt_file}", "{cwd}"], parser: "plain"}. Placeholders, replaced inside each argv element: {prompt} {prompt_file} {cwd} {job_dir} {session_uuid} {max_turns} {budget_usd}. args are an argv array run without a shell. envPass names host env vars handed to that agent when set; nothing else from the host env reaches it except PATH, HOME and LANG. Templates that use a CLI's bypass/yolo flag are refused unless allowBypass is true.

grok.$comment: These are the built-in grok args, spelled out. Grok 1.0.44 cancels headless runs under acceptEdits, so it uses --always-approve, which the runner only accepts together with Grok's Seatbelt workspace (or strict) sandbox; the --deny rules still win. Never --trust, so the clone's own .claude/.grok config stays untrusted.

claude.$comment: Built-in args: -p {prompt} --output-format json --permission-mode acceptEdits --permission-prompts none, a short allow list, git commit/push denied, --setting-sources user --strict-mcp-config --settings {"disableAllHooks":true}, --session-id/--max-turns/--max-budget-usd. Auth via CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

codex.$comment: Built-in args: exec --sandbox workspace-write --json -o {job_dir}/last-message.txt -C {cwd} --ignore-rules -, with the prompt on stdin. The sandbox keeps .git read-only and network off.

cursor.$comment: Use Cursor's absolute path: a bare `agent` may be Grok's agent binary. Cursor applies edits only with --force (its docs: same as --yolo), so this agent is refused until allowBypass is true. Only set that on a VM or container, keep --sandbox enabled, and add permissions.deny rules to ~/.cursor/cli-config.json.

script.$comment: Any program, run as <bin> {prompt_file} {cwd} and judged by its exit code. runner/note-agent.mjs is a model-free demo; a relative bin is resolved from this file's directory.
script.label: Note agent (no model)
